title: Potential diagnostic and therapeutic gene in chronic low back pain through pyroptosis modulation: A silico study based on the dataset analysis.
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于GEO数据集分析慢性下背痛中焦亡相关基因，纯转录组差异表达与机器学习诊断标志物筛选，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic low back pain (cLBP ) is a common condition that affects the quality of life, can be caused by disc degeneration, facet arthropathy, myofascial pain, sacroiliac joint pain, spondyloarthropathies, and nociplastic pain etc. Research suggests that excessive pyroptosis may trigger cytokine release and harmful inflammation, leading to tissue damage and organ dysfunction, which could be a potential molecular mechanism underlying these conditions. Our aim in this research was to look into the effects of genes associated with pyroptosis in cLBP, with the goal of describing possible markers for diagnosis and targets for treatment. A comprehensive analysis of Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs) was performed utilizing the GSE177034 datasets sourced from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) repository. GSE177034 included 98 patients admitted to the hospital for treatment of low back pain, all of whom had peripheral blood extracted and sequenced. We identified 883 DEGs, including 397 upregulated and 486 downregulated genes, in cLBP. The WGCNA revealed 11 co-expression modules, with the blue module presenting the utmost positive connection to pyroptosis. The GO and KEGG analyses showed that DEGs associated with pyroptosis were substantially enriched in pathways like the NF-kappaB transcription factor activity and the MyD88-dependent signaling pathway of Toll-like receptors. Machine learning approaches identified five pyroptosis relate hub genes (AVIL, PADI4, ARHGAP24, ST3GAL6, and BICDL2) as potential biomarkers. The cLBP diagnostic column chart model was established, demonstrating the accuracy of hub genes as biomarkers. A hub mRNA-related interaction network was constructed to identify potential therapeutic drugs, followed by verification of hub gene expression levels to validate their role in cLBP. Moreover, the investigation into immune cell infiltration revealed substantial disparities in the presence of five distinct immune cell types between the chronic LBP and acute LBP cohorts. Specifically, activated effector memory CD8 T cells (R = - 0.5407, p-value < 0.001) ,and CD56bright natural killer cells (R = - 0.5438, p-value < 0.001) were all found to be significantly different. These findings suggest that immune involvement may play a role in the development of cLBP. This study identified diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets for cLBP, offering promising avenues for improved diagnosis and treatment. The identification of specific biomarkers, including AVIL, PADI4, ARHGAP24, ST3GAL6, and BICDL2, enhances diagnostic precision by enabling the stratification of cLBP subtypes based on underlying pathophysiology.
abstract_zh: 慢性下背痛（cLBP）是一种常见疾病，影响生活质量，可能由椎间盘退变、小关节病、肌筋膜疼痛、骶髂关节痛、脊柱关节病及伤害可塑性疼痛等引起。研究表明，过度的细胞焦亡（pyroptosis）可能触发细胞因子释放和有害炎症，导致组织损伤和器官功能障碍，这可能是这些病症背后的潜在分子机制。本研究旨在探讨与细胞焦亡相关的基因在cLBP中的作用，旨在描述可能的诊断标志物和治疗靶点。利用源自基因表达综合库（GEO）的GSE177034数据集，对差异表达基因（DEGs）进行了全面分析。GSE177034包括98名因下背痛住院治疗的患者，所有患者均提取了外周血并进行测序。我们在cLBP中鉴定出883个DEGs，包括397个上调基因和486个下调基因。WGCNA揭示了11个共表达模块，其中蓝色模块与细胞焦亡呈现最强的正相关性。GO和KEGG分析显示，与细胞焦亡相关的DEGs显著富集于如NF-kappaB转录因子活性和Toll样受体的MyD88依赖性信号通路等通路中。机器学习方法识别出五个与细胞焦亡相关的核心基因（AVIL、PADI4、ARHGAP24、ST3GAL6和BICDL2）作为潜在生物标志物。建立了cLBP诊断列线图模型，证明了核心基因作为生物标志物的准确性。构建了核心mRNA相关相互作用网络以识别潜在治疗药物，随后验证了核心基因表达水平以确认其在cLBP中的作用。此外，免疫细胞浸润研究显示，慢性LBP和急性LBP队列之间五种不同免疫细胞类型的丰度存在显著差异。具体而言，活化效应记忆CD8 T细胞（R = - 0.5407，p值 < 0.001）和CD56bright自然杀伤细胞（R = - 0.5438，p值 < 0.001）均被发现显著不同。这些发现表明免疫参与可能在cLBP发展中发挥作用。本研究识别了cLBP的诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点，为改善诊断和治疗提供了有前景的途径。特定生物标志物（包括AVIL、PADI4、ARHGAP24、ST3GAL6和BICDL2）的识别，通过基于潜在病理生理学对cLBP亚型进行分层，增强了诊断精确性。
